data.name: Boomimals
data.detailed_description:
Boomimals is a frantic multiplayer tank brawler where every match spirals into explosive chaos. Battle as adorable animal tanks, collect game-breaking upgrade cards, and ricochet bouncing bullets around unpredictable arenas. Whether you're pulling off impossible trick shots or accidentally blowing yourself up, every round is something to remember.

Chaotic Tank Battles

Master the art of bouncing bullets off walls to eliminate your opponents. Precision, prediction, and a little bit of lady luck can turn a single shot into an outlandish victory.

Build Ridiculous Loadouts

Choose from a growing collection of unique cards that transform the way you play. Stack upgrades to create devastating combinations, surprising strategies, and game-breaking builds.

Every Arena Changes the Fight

Battle across a variety of handcrafted maps from us or your fellow players, each with unique layouts that reward creative ricochets, risky plays, and clever positioning.

Play With Friends

Jump into explosive matches with up to 4 players online or locally. Easy to learn, difficult to master, and guaranteed to create unforgettable moments.

Features

  • Online and local multiplayer for up to 4 players

  • Animal-themed tanks full of personality

  • Ricochet-based tank combat

  • Dozens of upgrade cards with endless combinations

  • Multiple unique arenas

  • Fast-paced rounds perfect for parties or competitive rematches

  • Easy to pick up, rewarding to master

  • Custom Map Builder to randomize gameplay even more

data.short_description: Battle your friends as chaotic animal tanks in fast-paced local or online PvP! Collect game-breaking upgrade cards, bounce bullets around unpredictable arenas, and outsmart your opponents in booming 2–4 player matches.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti (2 GB) or AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
